opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: £56,000 in year one, £28,000 in years two and three (salary contribution)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers who have not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post in the UK, must hold a doctorate and have submitted their thesis by the closing date.
opportunities.summary: Supports early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable research for up to three years, covering salary contributions and research expenses.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities or other UK higher‑education institutions (and, on a trial basis, UK‑based independent research institutes) may apply; principal investigator must be employed by the institution.
opportunities.summary: Funds innovative, original research projects of up to five years, with at least 75 % of resources for research staff.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university academic staff must coordinate the visit; specialist arts institutions, charities and other eligible UK organisations may apply as hosts.
opportunities.summary: Supports UK institutions to invite eminent overseas scholars for 3–12 month visits, covering salary, travel, subsistence and related costs.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career UK university academics (lecturer level or equivalent) with ≤ 2 years post‑PhD experience, no prior equivalent award, and not having led a research team.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1 million over 4–5 years to enable early‑career scholars to build and lead a modest research team.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary contribution (up to the university’s junior lecturer scale) plus up to £6,000 per year for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in humanities/social sciences employed by a UK university; must not have previously held a Major Research Fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Provides salary support for two‑ or three‑year fellowships, enabling distinguished scholars to complete a piece of original research.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired or partially retired UK university researchers who have been research‑active, live in the UK ≥ 26 weeks/year, and hold a UK university or eligible research institute affiliation.
opportunities.summary: Supports senior researchers to complete or integrate a research project after retirement, with modest funding for travel, consumables and research assistance.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship – Under 18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities delivering high‑quality fine/performing‑arts training for school‑age children (< 18 years).
opportunities.summary: Funds three‑year training programmes (e.g., weekend, evening or holiday courses) for outstanding under‑18 students, covering tuition, maintenance, equipment, travel and related costs.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship – Under/Postgraduate

amount.raw: £5,000 – £10,000 per student per year; maximum total award £475,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities offering undergraduate or postgraduate fine/performing‑arts programmes; universities are ineligible.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries of £5‑10k per student per year (up to three years) to support financially‑needful outstanding arts students.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Up to £5 million total across ten awards (approximately £500,000 per university)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree‑awarding powers may apply for up to 30 interdisciplinary doctoral scholarships (including provisions for under‑represented groups and international students).
opportunities.summary: Provides four‑year doctoral scholarships (including tuition, maintenance and £10,000 research/training fund) for up to 30 students per university, plus post‑doctoral and cohort‑building funding.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced UK‑based researchers holding a permanent post at a UK university; must be resident in the UK and have a track record of research impacted by teaching/administrative duties.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £70,000 for 3–24 month fellowships to enable experienced researchers to complete a piece of research hindered by routine duties.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (including Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial) may apply to establish interdisciplinary research centres of up to ten years duration.
opportunities.summary: Supports large‑scale, blue‑sky, multi‑disciplinary research centres aiming for step‑change impact; up to £10 million funding over up to ten years.
